items.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018
items.q: my © Fillius Jazz Archive -11- guitarist is somebody that I had a senior recital... And so David, he’s here tonight too with me.

ctx.x: I just had a question about whether you’d made it with the same band that you started out with or how you find a talent that will match yours you know?

Well that’s a good question. He knows about that. Well I actually have band members that I play with more than others because they are just there and they are amazing. But sometimes, depending on budget or depending on just curiosity even, with special guests and things like that, I might switch up something. Or if I’m playing on the west coast versus the east coast or if I’m traveling to another country, sometimes we’re invited to do my repertoire but with the band that plays at a particular venue. I will say…

guitarist is somebody that I had a senior recital, the guitarist I had did not learn the music, he didn’t practice, he came, he showed up, he was terrible and then he blamed it on everybody. “This isn’t my type of music.” I’m like, “You just didn’t practice.” But my recital was like coming up in three days and you know, recitals are hard. Like I was pulling in classical music and jazz and I was freaking out. And someone said, “I know this great guitarist, he’s amazing.” I think he was like a sophomore. And I was…
